name: American Robin
facts: Call pattern: a rolling carol of rising and falling phrases, often written "cheerily, cheer-up, cheerio." Usually among the first voices before sunrise.
Habitat: lawns, parks and woodland edges. Hunts earthworms by sight on open ground, then switches to fruit in fall and winter.
Migration: partial. Many shift south, but winter flocks linger in the Midwest wherever berries hold out.
